system.description:
Will Amp

When you enter your Crash state, by spending 1 Pressure, you become a Herald of storms. You gain a 40-foot fly speed and you may halve the damage dice granted by Crash, applying the halved amount to two separate jutsu cast while in this state.

While a Herald, hostile creatures gain a +1 bonus to their attack rolls when attacking you.
system.summary: Crash, plus a 40-foot fly speed; hostile creatures get +1 to attack you.

rules.text: 40-ft fly speed and +1 to attacks against you (on this effect). Crash's damage dice can be halved and applied to two jutsu.
rules.label: Chakra Surge: Crash (Herald)

rules.text: Once per casting, Ninjutsu you cast deal +1d10 damage (2d10 at 7th, 3d10 at 11th, 4d10 at 15th, 5d10 at 19th; half the dice for an area). This is added automatically when you cast.
You can use two or more Moldings on one casting; you can use the Draw Reserves skill action as an Action.
Herald: you may halve Crash's damage dice and apply the halved amount to two separate jutsu cast in this state.
